# AWS unified keyboard

This folder contains the keyboard engine supplied for Aza’raan Writing Studio.
The AWS floating shell owns the single movable 150 × 150 keyboard bubble,
open/close control, position, and resize handles. The embedded keyboard owns
QWERTY, Aza’raan layouts, sound choices, emoji, Print Screen, and speech.

The embed page hides the package’s demo writing desk and evolution page. Keys are
sent to the existing AWS rich-text editor or to the existing Language Studio
token editor. The hidden note field is an in-memory speech/selection buffer and
does not save manuscript text.

The html2canvas license file retains the screenshot dependency license from the
supplied package.
